name: GLSL LSP
description: Adds GLSL support: completion with every builtin type and function, hover docs, go-to-definition, diagnostics, #include resolution and formatting from glsl_analyzer in the sandboxed Linux rootfs, plus a bundled TextMate grammar (source.glsl) so every shader stage is coloured immediately, before - or entirely without - the server. The run button compiles the open shader with glslangValidator. Serves .glsl, .glsles, .vert, .frag, .geom, .comp, .tesc and .tese.
